title: feat(plugin-detail): the default record page drops the stage bar and key-field strip; the stage moves from the header tag
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu6iCLzAMRsv6Rp5pxzmbKve)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTcbvQNTSr6ij3TMW7

Fixes #35891
Fixes #35849

Part of epic #35590 (record page redo). Maintainer, 2026-11-20 17:16:59Z, on the fig. 41 direction for these two cards: 「把阶段条和关键字段条去掉，是的」.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new members: `RecordStageMenu` and `RecordStageMenuProps` on the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` entry, the `RecordHeaderStageParts` type and an optional `stage` member on `RecordHeaderState` in `@object-ui/components`, four `detail.stageMenu*` keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` locale, and `@objectstack/lint` `field-group-shadowed` accepting more (a highlighted member no longer counts as hidden from the body); nothing removed or renamed (`useStageChange`'s new third parameter is package-internal: the hook is not exported from the entry)
Metadata-protocol: semantic — the same metadata draws a different default record page: `highlightFields` no longer draws a strip or takes fields out of their groups, `stageField` draws the header tag's menu instead of a path
Skills-docs: follow-up #35942 (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` step 1 still says `highlightFields` draws a strip and `stageField` a stage path; a skills-lane card). This PR updates the hand-written docs: `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (the synthesized default and the `highlights` slot row), `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx` and `schema-design.mdx` (what `highlightFields` and `stageField` drive)

## 维护者速读
- 用户打开任意记录详情页时，顶部不再有阶段条和关键字段条；阶段改在记录名旁的状态标签上，点开下拉直接改，手机上也一样。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题：后台配的字段分组原样显示，不再有字段被抽走，查看和编辑时字段的位置一致。
- 有编辑权限的人改阶段时会先确认，某阶段要求补填的字段（如丢单原因）会在同一个框里填完一起保存；服务端拒绝时阶段不动，原因就显示在框里。自定义页面里仍可放回这两个组件，改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## Why

Epic #35590 redraws the record page to fig. 41: one header row, then the record's own groups. The maintainer confirmed dropping the stage bar and the key-field strip (quoted above), which leaves the header's status tag as the only place the stage is read, so it becomes the place it is moved. With the strip gone, nothing needs to be taken out of the groups, which is #35849's 「后台配的分组原样生效」.

## What changes

**The default record page (`buildDefaultPageSchema`)** no longer emits `record:highlights` or `record:path`. Its shape is now `page:header`, then an authored `highlights` slot if one is given, then `page:tabs`.

**Field groups as configured (#35849).** The details body draws every field its groups hold. The highlight fields and the stage field are no longer taken out of their groups (`headerDrawnFields` and `drawnPathField` are gone, `synthTabs` no longer takes a hidden list). `highlightFields` is unchanged and still drives the hover card, a related list's default columns and the record picker. Nothing is picked when an object declares none (#28868 kept). Of #35849's three items, the read-only top row is no longer needed once the strip is gone, as the coordinator's comment on the card says.

**The stage moves from the header's status tag (#35891).**
- `@object-ui/components`: `RecordHeaderState` gains an optional `stage` renderer, `(parts: RecordHeaderStageParts) => ReactNode`. The header calls it with the tag it would draw (field, label, tag) and draws the result in the host bar and in its own row. Without a host bar (a phone) the header now draws the stage tag in the row under the record's name, beside the state's tags. Before, a phone showed no stage at all.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: new `RecordStageMenu`. A reader who may edit the stage field sees the tag with an arrow; it opens a menu listing every stage in order, the current one checked. A stage the field's blocking `state_machine` cannot reach is disabled, with its reason under the name. Picking a stage opens a confirm dialog focused on Move (Enter confirms), or on the first field it asks for.
- A stage that makes other fields required (their `requiredWhen` holds once the record stands on it, for example a loss reason on a lost stage) asks for exactly those fields in the same dialog, and the move and the values go in one write with `ifMatch`. A server refusal stays in the dialog, beside the field it names (a field the menu did not know about is added to the form), and the stage does not move. The server stays the validation authority; the client only decides which fields to ask for.
- A reader without the edit grant on the field, a page that may not edit (an approval lock included) or an open draft sees the plain tag, no arrow. A plain status field (no stage role) is read and moved the same way.
- The package-internal `useStageChange` takes `{ collectFields: true }` for this dialog; `record:path` keeps its plain confirmation and its Cancel-first focus.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `RecordDetailView`: one hunk, hands `RecordStageMenu` to the header as `recordHeaderState.stage`. The record header's two-row work (#35853) is in flight on another branch; the menu is built on the current tag and rides wherever #35853 puts the status tag.

**Kept for authored pages.** `buildDefaultHighlights` and both blocks stay: an authored page, or a slotted page's `highlights` slot, still places a strip and a path where it wants them.

**Lint.** `field-group-shadowed` (packages/lint) no longer counts the highlight strip as hiding fields from the detail body. A group whose only visible member is the record title still warns.

**i18n.** Four `detail.stageMenu*` strings in every locale; zh-Hant regenerated from zh-Hans by `gen:zh-hant`.

**Platform checklist.** `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` r17: a full record page copies the default, which now carries no strip and no bar, so acceptance[0] asks for the default's blocks and neither block. `records-forms.master-detail-body-tables` acceptance[0] still says the Tasks table sits "under the header strip's stage bar and key fields"; that item belongs to #35889's change of the master-detail default, so it is left to that PR (listed as a follow-up below).

## Tests

<details><summary>Migrated (the old rule pinned the strip, the path or the hidden list)</summary>

- `plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts`: default types are `page:header`, `page:tabs`; a control pins that `buildDefaultHighlights` still emits both blocks; the options-override case runs on the sub-builder; the slot case now says the slot places the strip the page draws.
- `plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/highlights-declaredOnly-28868.test.ts`: sections 2 and 3 rewritten to the new rule (no strip, no path, `hideFields` undefined in every case); `deriveHighlightFields` still reads the declared list minus the title, at most six.
- `plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.strictPayload.test.ts`: `record:highlights` and `record:path` leave the emitted-type list.
- `plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.bodyTables-27055.test.ts`: declared key fields draw no strip; the staged case places its strip through the `highlights` slot.
- `plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.stageChange-28199.test.tsx`: a `stripPage` helper places `buildDefaultHighlights` in the slot; describe names say "the synthesized strip".
- `plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-highlights.groupGate-12720.test.tsx`: the strip node comes from `buildDefaultHighlights`.
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.test.tsx`: uses a slotted strip.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx`: the header keeps its subtitle and draws no strip under it; the strip's fields read in their groups.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.lookupDependsOn-7190.test.tsx`: both `InlineFieldInput` call sites stay pinned; the strip is placed through a slotted page's `highlights` slot (`stripPage`), holding the list each case declares. Ablated: without the slotted page the strip-site prune case fails.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.updateActionRefresh-29935.test.tsx`: the stage is read from the header's stage tag instead of the path bar's current step.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909.test.tsx`: no strip at 390 or 1440, and the meta line names the owner at both (it used to be left out on a desktop, where the strip named it).
- `ui/e2e/record-tabs-rail-35595.spec.ts` (Playwright, found red on CI Build & E2E UI at `7886ee09`): the fixture places the stage path and key fields through the `highlights` slot (`buildDefaultHighlights`), as an authored page does; the span-both-columns and "another tab draws no strip" assertions are unchanged. 6 of 6 pass locally on chromium.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-semantic-roles.test.ts`: rule (d) cases rewritten; positions 1 to 6 of a declared list come out clean; title-only still flags, with a hidden-member case and a control; the #6326 primaryField case uses a group holding only `ref_no`.

</details>

<details><summary>Voided (the behaviour is gone by the maintainer's ruling)</summary>

- lint: "flags a group fully shadowed by the highlight strip (rule d)" and "rule d judges the six highlights the record page hoists, not four". The default page no longer hoists highlights, so there is nothing to shadow; replaced by "rule d no longer counts highlights as hidden from the body".
- 28868: "a declared entry past the sixth is drawn by the body, not dropped from both", "the stage joins a declared strip's hide list, once", "control: no path (stageField: false)…", "control: a status field with no stages to draw…", "an authored highlights slot decides: its record:path hides the stage…". The body hides nothing now, so each of these collapses into "the body hides nothing" (kept as new cases above).
- buildDefaultPageSchema: "omits record:path when no status field" and "omits record:highlights when no fields derivable". The default page omits both always.

</details>

<details><summary>New</summary>

- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx` (15): menu order and current stage; unreachable stage disabled with its reason; confirm writes with `ifMatch` and re-reads; cancel writes nothing; Closed Lost asks for the loss reason only and writes it with the move; an empty submission's server refusal stays in the dialog beside the field and nothing re-reads; a refusal naming an unknown field adds it; a non-field refusal reads under the form; the plain tag for `canEdit: false` and for a denied field grant, with a control; keyboard: Enter opens, Escape closes, the dialog opens focused on Move (or on the first field), and `record:path` keeps Cancel first. The two focus cases were ablated: with the focus hook removed they fail.
- `components/src/__tests__/page-header-stage-tag-35891.test.tsx` (5): the phone row draws the stage tag first; the host `stage` receives field, label and tag and replaces the plain tag; the host control draws in the bar's title slot; no stage value means no tag and no call.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The owner, once (#28868): the meta line leaves the owner out only when a drawn strip carries it, and the default page draws none, so the meta line now names the owner at every width. An object whose field groups place `owner_id` also shows it in the body, so the owner is named twice there. That was already the case on `main` for an object declaring no highlights; with highlights declared it is new. Not changed here: follow-up #35941.
- "Readers without edit rights see no arrow" is read through the same verdict `record:path` uses (`useStageChange`: page `canEdit`, which an approval lock already turns off, field readonly or computed, the field's `recordEdit` affordance and the row-scoped field grant).
- The phone keeps the same console (#35880 constraint 1): the header row under the name is what a phone shows, and it now carries the stage.
- Twenty was read for structure only; no code copied.

## Verification

<details><summary>Browser (showcase, built console, 1280 and 375 wide, light and dark)</summary>

Evidence in `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35891/` (project files).
- Semantic zoo record: no strip, no path; Status stays in its Basics group; the arrowed stage tag opens the menu (current stage checked, every stage listed) at 1280 and 375, light and dark; no horizontal scroll at either width (scrollWidth 1280 and 375).
- Keyboard only: focus the tag, Enter opens, arrows move to Done, Enter picks, the dialog opens focused on Move, Enter confirms; the tag reads Done and still reads Done after a reload (the API returns the new status). Before the focus fix, Enter hit Cancel; that run is why the focus hook exists.
- Invoice INV-1001 uses an authored page under a pending approval: no stage menu there, as intended.
- The fields a stage needs (L1-c finding 3), at 1280 and 375, record in `browser-check-fields-dialog.md` beside the screenshots. With a temporary, uncommitted `requiredWhen: 'record.status == "done"'` on the zoo's `code`: picking Done opens a dialog holding only Code, focused; Move with Code empty keeps the dialog open with 「Code不能为空」 under the field and the API status `active`; filling Code and Move closes it, the tag reads Done, the API stores both. A bare PATCH to `done` answered `VALIDATION_FAILED` naming `code`, so the server is the authority. No horizontal scroll at either width.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 71 commands, all exit 0. Two first answered non-zero for the box, not the diff, and were re-run: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 until its pinned fixture commit was fetched (shallow clone), and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` killed for memory while a parallel eslint ran.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` and `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: OK. `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: within ceilings.
- vitest from `ui/`: all of `packages/app-shell` (2351 files, 22049 tests: 4 failed on the old rule, migrated as listed under Tests, then the RecordDetailView files re-run green), all of `packages/components`, `packages/plugin-detail` and `packages/i18n` (994 files, 10360 tests, 0 failed). After merging `main`: the RecordDetailView files, plugin-detail `synth`, the two new test files and `packages/i18n` again, 0 failed.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `validate-semantic-roles.test.ts` 30 passed; `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and the test tsconfig) for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0. ESLint over every changed `.ts`/`.tsx`: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: conflicted with #35925 (#35900, the group `fields` list) in `packages/lint/src/validate-semantic-roles.ts`, rule (d). #35925 landed first (`170ca481`); resolved in the `main` merge below.
- After the `main` merge with #35925: `@objectstack/lint` `validate-semantic-roles.test.ts` 34 passed; plugin-detail `synth` re-run.

</details>

Follow-ups (not in this PR):
- Follow-up: #35941 (owner shown twice when a field group draws owner_id; pre-existing on main)
- follow-up: #35889 — `records-forms.master-detail-body-tables` acceptance[0] wording ("under the header strip's stage bar and key fields"), with its rewrite of that item.
- follow-up: #35943 — retiring `BuildPageOptions.highlightFields` / `.statusField` / `.stages` and the phone-capped list `RecordDetailView` passes in; the generated `record:details.hideFields` description ("the synth pipeline fills it with the fields already shown in `record:highlights`") and the `highlightFields` describe and Studio help text in `packages/spec` ("record-detail highlight strip"); both regenerate from spec sources; and the stale comments that still describe the hoisting rule: the JSDoc of `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, the semantic-zoo object's comment on `highlightFields` in `examples/app-showcase`, and the dogfood test comment that cites it.

Flow: built in the card thread (dev-thread flow); L1 by the L1-c review thread, the seat adopts and lands.

## Rework round 1 (L1-c 7050407052)

- must-fix 1: the `skills/**` hunk is reverted (`7886ee09`); the skill text is follow-up #35942.
- should-fix 2: follow-ups carry cards: #35942 (skill), #35943 (spec describe, Studio help, generated `hideFields` text, stale comments), #35889 (the master-detail checklist item), #35941 (owner shown twice).
- should-fix 3: the browser run of the fields dialog at 1280 and 375 is done (Verification).
- nit 4: the signature line no longer carries the area suffix.
- CI at `7886ee09`: Build & E2E UI failed two cases of `record-tabs-rail-35595.spec.ts` that read the strip on the default page; migrated at `723d2890` (Tests).

## Merge with #35925 and declaration L2 should-fix (7051547558)

- `main` merged at `170ca481` (#35925). The one conflict was the import block of `validate-semantic-roles.ts`: `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` stays dropped, `readFieldGroupMembership` is kept. Rule (d) now counts a group's members the way the layout resolves them (#35925: the group's own `fields` list first, then `Field.group`) and hides only the record title from the body (this PR). Both hold.
- #35925 added a rule (d) case that expected `highlightFields: ['name', 'code']` to shadow a group listing `code` and `name`. Under this PR the highlighted `code` is drawn in the body, so the case is migrated: that object now comes out clean, and a group listing only the title still flags `field-group-shadowed`.
- should-fix S1: `BuildPageOptions.highlightFields`, `.statusField` and `.stages` are marked accepted-but-unread in their JSDoc for `buildDefaultPageSchema` and `buildDefaultTabs` (the `primaryField` pattern, objectui#7287); `buildDefaultHighlights` still reads them. The changeset says they no longer do anything on the default page. The two dead pass-throughs into `synthTabs` are dropped. Retiring the keys, and the phone-capped `highlightFields` that `RecordDetailView` still computes and passes in (kept here to hold that file to one hunk), is follow-up #35943.
- nits: the `Clause-②` line no longer lists `useStageChange`'s third parameter, which is package-internal, and now names the `field-group-shadowed` widening.
